newsitem.title: GERMANY: UBS upgrades Deutsche Bank to buy.
newsitem.headline: UBS upgrades Deutsche Bank to buy.

text.p: Investment bank UBS has upgraded its recommendation for commercial bank Deutsche Bank AG from "hold" to "buy", a spokeswoman at UBS's Frankfurt office confirmed on Thursday.
She could not immediately confirm dealer talk that the upgrade, which is thought to have been published on Wednesday, was based on expectations of cost-cutting at Deutsche.
She added that she understood the recommendation had been made by UBS's London-based banking analyst, who was not immediately available to comment.
Deutsche shares gained 67 pfennigs to 71.80 marks in IBIS trade by 0804 GMT.

Dealers said they believed the recommendation was, aside from expectations of cost-cutting, also based on Deutsche being able to finish spending on its investment bank business by around mid-1997, thus boosting future earnings potential.
